info.title: dbapi-loanOffers-privatebanking
info.description: Easily request loan offers on behalf of your customer.

post.summary: Request an offer for a loan.
post.description: By providing data about the prospect and needed loan one can request a loan offer. The result is a unique offer id which can be used with the other endpoints for status retrieval or additional processing.

parameters.name: idempotency-id
parameters.description: Unique id of the service call. Should be resent during retries to avoid multiple processing of the same request

parameters.name: Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Free form key controlled by the caller e.g. uuid

requestBody.description: Request an offer for a loan

post.summary: Commit uploaded documents and start processing the loan offer case.
post.description:
This operation finalizes the document upload process for the specified loan offer by confirming that all required documents have been successfully submitted. 
Once triggered, the system initiates the internal processing of the case based on the uploaded documents. This endpoint should be called only after all intended documents for the case have been uploaded via the corresponding upload endpoint.

parameters.name: idempotency-id
parameters.description: Unique id of the service call. Should be resent during retries to avoid multiple processing of the same request

parameters.name: Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Free form key controlled by the caller e.g. uuid

requestBody.description: Payload carrying transactionId for this upload session.

post.summary: Generate a new transactionId for a document upload session.
post.description: Generates a unique transactionId to be used for a new upload session. Each upload session (one or more document uploads followed by a single startCase call) requires a fresh transactionId. The generated transactionId must be used in subsequent document upload and startCase calls for this session.

environment.description: Identifies the environment in which the request should be processed.

callbackUrl.description: Callback URL provided for asynchronous notifications and document delivery related to the loan offers request. If missing, the default configuration will be applied.

conditionRequest.description: Set to 'true' if this is solely a request for loan conditions and not a full application. When 'true', only an offer proposal will be generated and no formal contract processing will occur.

contextId.description: Identifier that facilitates the internal processing and tracking of a loan application, particularly for provisioning purposes. This ID ensures consistent referencing throughout the loan lifecycle.

productName.description: Name of the product/conditions, to be agreed on between consumer/bank

requestedVersion.description: Application version to handle the request

deposit.description: The deposit made for the car

firstRegistrationDate.description: The first registration date of the car. [ISO Date. I.e. YYYY-MM-DD]

isNewCar.description: Whether a new or used car is being purchased

documentName.description: Name of the delivered document (i.e. account statement)

RankPosition.description: Debtor the transaction data belongs to. First or second debtor

Source.description: Source format of the transaction data

Target.description: Target format of the transaction data

bic.description: BIC ( Bank Identifier Code) of the account

ownerName.description: Full name of the account owner

PaymentType.description: Exactly one disbursement and direct debit account are always required

amount.description: Account balance of the loan to be restructured

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth of the debtor. [ISO Date. I.e. YYYY-MM-DD]

inGermanySince.description: Residence in Germany since [ISO Date. I.e. YYYY-MM-DD]

nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country belonging to the nationality

listAdditionalNationalities.description: Additional nationalities of the debtor. Use this field if the debtor holds more than one nationality. Provide one or more ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.

numberOfChildren.description: Number of (dependent) children of the debtor

tin.description: Taxpayer identification number of the debtor

workPermitValidUntil.description: Date by when the working permit ends. [ISO Date. I.e. YYYY-MM-DD]

residencyPermitValidUntil.description: Date by when the residence permit ends. [ISO Date. I.e. YYYY-MM-DD]

Sex.description: Sex of the debtor, also determines salutation

country.description: Country the address is located in [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country]

ownProperty.description: True if living in a self owned property

residenceAddressSince.description: Start date of living at the current address, only needed if there was a move in the last 2 years and predecessor address is also available. [ISO Date. I.e. YYYY-MM-DD]

disability.description: Whether the customer has an existing disability insurance

residualDebt.description: Whether the customer has an existing residual debt insurance

unemployment.description: Whether the customer has an existing unemployment insurance

employmentStart.description: Start date of current employment. [ISO Date. I.e. YYYY-MM-DD]

shortTermEmploymentEndDate.description: Short term employment end date. [ISO Date. I.e. YYYY-MM-DD]

redemptionPayments.description: Monthly redemption payments for existing loans

nonSelfEmployment.description: Monthly non self employment net income

insurancePercentage.description: Insurance percentage, only multiples of 10 are valid

RequestedInsuranceType.description: Insurance type, residual debt is mandatory if any other insurances are requested

emailNotification.description: Select if status updates of the loan should be sent to the agent instead of the customer

homepage.description: URL to the homepage of the agent

type.description: Agent type, to be agreed on with the bank

transactionId.description: A unique transactionId to be used for one upload session (n document uploads + 1 startCase).
Unique transaction id of the upload session.

requirementType.description: Type of document required for processing the loan application (e.g. SALARY_CERTIFICATE, LOAN_CONTRACT,RESIDENCE_PERMIT)

fileName.description: Immutable name of the document file as given by the creator of the document.

data.description: Document content as Base64 encoded string.

mimeType.description: Media type of the document (e.g. application/pdf, image/tiff.).

message.description: Description of the belonging error code.

messageId.description: dbAPI internal message-id (unique identifier) that allow reference to each of your API calls.

transactionId.description: Unique transaction id for this upload session.
